summary: A creative, open-ended play world full of surprises, fun and stories for kids
description:
EXPLORE AN OPEN WORLD AND CREATE YOUR OWN STORIES!
Welcome to PangoLand! Pango and his friends open the doors of their homes so you can play, explore, and imagine freely. Walk through a world filled with objects to interact with, animations to trigger, and little surprises to discover everywhere.

In PangoLand, there is no single way to play. You can stay warm and cozy, light a fire, decorate the tree, and share a meal with the animals. Or head out on an adventure by car, explore the surroundings, switch from day to night, and discover new activities whenever you like.

Help Rabbit grow vegetables in the garden, build a robot in Fox’s workshop, or make a snowman with Pig. Each place offers simple, fun, and interactive actions to create unique stories, again and again.

PangoLand is a free exploration game that encourages imagination, curiosity, and independence. A gentle and reassuring experience, perfectly suited for children aged 3 and up.

A PANGO CREATION
For over 15 years, Pango games have supported children in their first discoveries with kind, accessible, and stress-free experiences. PangoLand continues this tradition by offering an open world designed for free play, with no imposed rules and no objectives to reach.

WHY DO PARENTS LOVE PANGOLAND?
- A large open world to explore freely
- Hundreds of objects and interactions
- Encourages imagination and pretend play
- Develops curiosity and independence
- Ability to switch from day to night
- A gentle, colorful, and reassuring world
- No stress, no scores, play at your own pace
- Perfect for children aged 3 and up

A 100% SAFE GAME FOR CHILDREN
• No in-app purchases
• No advertising
• No external links
• Built-in parental controls
• Compliant with child data protection regulations

PANGO VALUES: FREEDOM, IMAGINATION, KINDNESS
At Pango, we create worlds designed from a child’s perspective, respecting each child’s pace and leaving plenty of room for imagination.

Need help? A question? pango@studio-pango.com
